capabilities.name: agent.create
capabilities.notes: wire agent_create forwards a generic create body to the agents API; this is the canonical resource create

capabilities.name: agent.createPreset
capabilities.notes: wire create_agent builds an agent from a built-in personality preset (memo/tutorial/blank/linus/kawaii); kept separate from agent.create until the T-6 merge is measured

capabilities.name: agent.delete
capabilities.notes: wire agent_delete deletes one agent by agent_id; the wire carries no runtime scope

capabilities.name: agent.get
capabilities.notes: wire agent_retrieve reads one agent by agent_id; the wire carries no runtime scope

capabilities.name: agent.list
capabilities.notes: wire agent_list queries the agent registry and is callable before any runtime starts

capabilities.name: agent.update
capabilities.notes: wire agent_update patches one agent through a forwarded update body; no runtime scope on the wire

capabilities.name: conversation.create
capabilities.notes: wire conversation_create creates a conversation from a create body; no runtime scope on the wire

capabilities.name: conversation.delete
capabilities.notes: wire conversation_delete deletes a hidden conversation by conversation_id; no runtime scope on the wire

capabilities.name: conversation.fork
capabilities.notes: wire conversation_fork forks one conversation and returns the child id in the response; no runtime scope on the wire

capabilities.name: conversation.get
capabilities.notes: wire conversation_retrieve reads one conversation by conversation_id; no runtime scope on the wire

capabilities.name: conversation.list
capabilities.notes: wire conversation_list lists conversation rows for the sidebar before runtime_start; no runtime scope on the wire

capabilities.name: conversation.recompile
capabilities.notes: wire conversation_recompile applies pending model or toolset changes to one conversation; no runtime scope on the wire

capabilities.name: conversation.switch
capabilities.notes: wire id is runtime_start; the UI semantic is switching or starting a conversation runtime

capabilities.name: conversation.sync
capabilities.notes: wire sync replays runtime state; sync_response returns only when request_id is set and the replay itself arrives as state frames

capabilities.name: conversation.update
capabilities.notes: wire conversation_update patches one conversation through a forwarded update body; no runtime scope on the wire

capabilities.name: device.info
capabilities.notes: wire app_server_info is the post-auth handshake carrying backend, engine version, protocol version and capability flags

capabilities.name: device.setState
capabilities.notes: wire change_device_state sets permission mode, cwd and the bound agent/conversation for one runtime scope; there is no response and the result arrives as update_device_status

capabilities.name: file.edit
capabilities.notes: wire edit_file replaces an exact old string with a new string in one file

capabilities.name: file.ops
capabilities.notes: wire file_ops carries Egwalker CRDT ops in both directions for collaborative editing; legacy, no helper is built

capabilities.name: file.read
capabilities.notes: wire read_file reads one file as utf8 text or base64 bytes

capabilities.name: file.unwatch
capabilities.notes: wire unwatch_file stops the single-file watcher; there is no response and changes are observed as file_changed events

capabilities.name: file.watch
capabilities.notes: wire watch_file starts a single-file watcher; there is no response, failures are silent and changes arrive as file_changed events

capabilities.name: file.write
capabilities.notes: wire write_file writes full file content to one absolute path

capabilities.name: message.abort
capabilities.notes: wire abort_message interrupts the active turn; abort_message_response is optional and the authoritative result arrives as state frames

capabilities.name: message.list
capabilities.notes: wire conversation_messages_list pages the messages of one conversation; named under the message domain because it lists messages and turns, not conversation metadata

capabilities.name: message.send
capabilities.notes: only input_accepted comes back; the result is observed through stream_delta and status frames

capabilities.name: queue.remove
capabilities.notes: wire remove_queue_item removes one parked queue item without stopping the active turn

capabilities.name: queue.resume
capabilities.notes: wire resume_queue releases queue items parked by an interrupt; unlike remove_queue_item its wire carries a ConversationRuntimeScope

capabilities.name: queue.stopMonitor
capabilities.notes: wire monitor_stop kills a running background monitor process owned by one runtime scope; grouped with the queue domain as background task control

capabilities.name: slash.exec
capabilities.notes: wire execute_command runs a slash command; the 14 slash ids are arguments tracked in the watch list, not separate capabilities, and the output is a single string

capabilities.name: terminal.input
capabilities.notes: wire terminal_input writes raw data into one PTY; output is observed as terminal_output frames

capabilities.name: terminal.kill
capabilities.notes: wire terminal_kill terminates one PTY; the exit is observed as a terminal_exited frame

capabilities.name: terminal.resize
capabilities.notes: wire terminal_resize updates PTY columns and rows; there is no response

capabilities.name: terminal.spawn
capabilities.notes: wire terminal_spawn opens a PTY for a client-supplied terminal_id; readiness and output arrive as terminal_spawned and terminal_output frames

capabilities.name: workspace.cwdMap
capabilities.notes: wire get_cwd_map reads persisted per-conversation cwd overrides plus the boot working directory

capabilities.name: workspace.grep
capabilities.notes: wire grep_in_files returns line-level content matches with snippet context, not a file list

capabilities.name: workspace.list
capabilities.notes: wire list_in_directory pages folders and files for one absolute directory path

capabilities.name: workspace.search
capabilities.notes: wire search_files matches file paths under a root; content search is workspace.grep

capabilities.name: workspace.setBootCwd
capabilities.notes: wire set_boot_working_directory sets the boot cwd used by conversations without an override

capabilities.name: workspace.tree
capabilities.notes: wire get_tree returns a depth-bounded subtree rooted at one absolute path
